verdict.rationale: EBANX documents tracking of scheduled payouts and settlement history with financial visibility, and its marketing mentions unified reconciliation. Nothing shows the user can control the payout schedule or see an itemized breakdown of charges, fees, and refunds per payout. Missing for 10: user control over payout/settlement schedule, a per-payout itemized breakdown of charges, fees, and refunds, a reconciliation report or API detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can control the payout schedule and see exactly which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout

citations.quote: Track your available balance, scheduled payouts, and settlement history in real time with full financial visibility.
